summary: First iteration testing of Supervision 2.0. All 20 backend tests pass. Frontend UI fully functional. Key flows tested: auth (all 3 roles), meetings CRUD, recording events, admin standards/users.

minor.issue: Endpoints require a JSON body even though all fields are optional (sending no body causes 422). Frontend likely handles this correctly, but API docs/clients should send empty {}.

integration_issues.issue: In browser automation environment (no microphone), recording fails with 'Failed to start recording: Requested device not found'. This is expected behavior in headless browser, not a real bug.

issues: Users table is in a separate tab ('Users (3)') within Standards Library, not a standalone data-testid='users-table' on the page. Tab-based navigation works correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Recording endpoints (start/pause/resume/stop) require JSON body even though fields are optional - FastAPI returns 422 if Content-Type not set to application/json. Consider making the body truly optional using request body with default None.
seed_admin does NOT update existing manager/staff test users if passwords change (only admin gets idempotent update). Minor but fine for test data.
Date picker uses browser native datetime-local input, not shadcn calendar - minor design inconsistency but functional.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work, recording requires real microphone)

seed_data_creation: Test meetings created by pytest (TEST_Meeting_pytest, TEST_Recording_pytest) - visible in dashboard
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows verified. Backend 100% passing. Frontend: login, dashboard, new meeting (2-step), recording notice/screen, admin library (CQC 14 + Care Cert 16 + Users 3), logout - all working. Recording audio capture fails in headless browser (expected). Consider testing: processing/upload flow, review/sign-off flow, meeting report page.
